# Sem imigração

```{r}
pacman::p_load(plotly)

source("funcs.R")

obj = BDP_base(a = 19, t_max = 1,
               theta_update_func = theta_update_simple_linear,
               theta = c(0.5, 0.3))
plotly_process(obj)
```

# Com imigracao

